references.text: The atonement money from the Israelites was to be used for the service of the tent of meeting, as a memorial before the Lord for the Israelites.
Aaron's breastpiece with the stones of remembrance was to be carried before the Lord as a continual reminder of the children of Israel.
Aaron was to carry the names of the Israelites on his heart before the Lord as a continual reminder.
The commanders brought gold jewelry as an offering to the Lord to make atonement for themselves.
The total amount of gold given as a gift by the commanders of thousands and commanders of hundreds.
The tent of meeting was the place where the glory of the Lord dwelt, and where gifts were brought before his presence.
The stones from the Jordan were set up as a memorial for the children of Israel, just as the gold was a memorial.
Moses was told to write down the victory as a memorial in a book.
The widow's gift at the temple shows how voluntary gifts given from the heart were brought into the Lord's house.
